description: Test suite for the User API Key Authentication component within the litellm project. Contains unit tests for the get_api_key function, team metadata propagation, route checking for LLM API routes, and key expiration handling including cache behavior.

classes.name: LiteLLM_TeamTable
classes.description: Data class representing a team object with metadata including tags, used to test metadata propagation.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Class representing user API key authentication details, used to verify proper mapping of team metadata including tags.

methods.name: test_get_api_key()
methods.description: Tests retrieval of API key from a bearer token string, ensuring correct extraction.

methods.name: test_get_api_key_with_custom_litellm_key_header( custom_litellm_key_header, api_key, passed_in_key )
methods.description: Parameterizes testing of various custom header formats, verifying correct API key parsing.

methods.name: test_team_metadata_with_tags_flows_through_jwt_auth()
methods.description: Verifies that team metadata (including tags) correctly propagates into UserAPIKeyAuth objects.

methods.name: test_route_checks_is_llm_api_route()
methods.description: Extensively tests RouteChecks.is_llm_api_route for correct identification across valid routes, passthroughs, MCP, Azure, placeholder, and invalid cases.

methods.name: test_proxy_admin_expired_key_from_cache()
methods.description: Async regression test ensuring expired keys retrieved from cache are rejected and deleted, with proper exception raising.
